_comment: Phase 2 lever check: same KV memory as every W1 run (CTX = 24576 tokens) but one unified pool shared by 8 slots (--kv-unified), each slot capped at 6,144 tokens so every W1 task still fits, and FIFO c = 8. W1 tasks peak at ~2.7K tokens (median), and the 4 x 6,144 static slots hold only 37% of the pool on average, so a shared pool should allow a bigger decode batch. No admission control yet: if the pool overflows, llama.cpp purges idle slots and may fail requests, which this run should reveal (check errors and server_logs). Pair with w1_fifo_c5_l95 from phase2_cf (same seed, same session): python -m analysis.paired results/phase2_cf results/phase2_kvu_probe --baseline fifo_c5. One run, ~15 min.
name: phase2_kvu_probe
